summary: Created a 9-phase implementation plan covering all four work items. Core finding driving the shape: translation-server integration needs a NEW zotero-write.sh operation (item-add-json) because zot add has no JSON-body option (reconfirmed live at plan time), so Work Item 1 is capability work, not wiring. Phases 1-2 add item-add-json and an orphan-clean wrapper around zot orphans clean; phases 3-6 add the translation-server resolution helper, rework the resolvable branch to create-then-attach, add an explicit quota-aware auto-attach policy with a reactive 413-parsed cache, and surface resolution_path/attachment_state in the corpus index; phases 7-8 write the docs including the zotero-mcp defer decision and the plan-only Zotero 10 backend-swap plan; phase 9 runs static gates and puts three genuinely gated actions (cross-repo translation-server enable/test, a live production write, orphan cleanup) to the operator with stated decline paths. All edits target agent-system/extensions/literature/**; nothing touches .claude/** or ~/.dotfiles.
